description: This file contains Python code related to transforming constraints into z3 format for symbolic reasoning, specifically within the context of Torch FX's experimental module for migrating gradual types. It includes functions for converting various constraint types, managing variable transformations, and evaluating constraints, indicating it is a core source file defining key transformation logic.

methods.name: transform_to_z3(constraint, counter, dimension_dict)
methods.description: Recursively transforms a constraint into a z3 expression based on constraint type, supporting conjunctions, disjunctions, boolean constraints, and algebraic constraints.

methods.name: transform_var(tensor, counter, dimension_dict)
methods.description: Transforms tensor variables into z3 format, including handling of tensor types, dynamic dimensions, and variable dimensions.

methods.name: transform_dimension(dimension, counter, dimension_dict)
methods.description: Converts dimension variables or constants into a tuple representation used in z3 constraints, managing dynamic dimensions with a counter.

methods.name: transform_algebraic_expression(expr, counter, dimension_dict)
methods.description: Transforms algebraic expressions involving dimensions or products into z3 expressions, supporting basic arithmetic operations.

methods.name: transform_all_constraints(traced, counter=0)
methods.description: Generates and transforms constraints from a traced graph into z3 expressions, applying fixed point iteration for constraint simplification.

methods.name: iterate_till_fixed_point(constraints, counter)
methods.description: Iteratively transforms constraints until reaching a fixed point, ensuring constraints are fully converted.

methods.name: transform_all_constraints_trace_time(tracer_root, graph, node, counter=0)
methods.description: Transforms constraints associated with a specific node in a graph, generating positive and negative constraint sets for conditional analysis.

methods.name: evaluate_conditional_with_constraints( tracer_root, graph, node, counter=0, user_constraints=None )
methods.description: Evaluates a node's condition and its negation within a set of constraints using z3 solver, for symbolic reasoning about conditional branches.
